summary: Re-review of edee50b..cc8afbd (tasks 4.13e to 4.13h, text commits def8681 and 84e254e). The fake-tested contracts hold end to end. review-run.sh refuses a message file with a second line, a control character, a line over 1000 bytes, or a link, and a linked seeded diff, with one review-run: line and exit 2 (M5 to M9). judge-run.sh refuses a judges.json row with an empty quota field or a tab (J18 to J18c), prints <route> ready|not-ready at the Go thresholds (G3), and judged_by holds only ids with a verdict (J19, C7 resolved). seed-messages.ts holds every listed refusal, and SM4 pins each (R3 resolved). The net-above-0 pick rule shows the same in real-work.html, real-work.ts, and guide.ts, and the footer row count equals the outcomes length (DS26). All four allowed suites pass at HEAD (52, 30, 17, 16 tests) with no orphan process. But the Go thresholds of the PM order of 2026-11-19 cannot work against the live source. I read the live OpenChamber endpoint GET /api/quota/opencode-go: the week window is named weekly, and the answer holds credits_balance with usedPercent null. quota.ts reads windows[week], so the week-100 rule is dead live (F1). parseAnswer rejects the null credits_balance window, so every live Go read stops before any threshold is checked; I ran quota.ts against the live base and got state stopped with the line quota: the window credits_balance holds no usable usedPercent (F2). Review A found both breaks at the same HEAD, and an uncommitted task 4.13i Red (working-tree edits at 01:09 and 01:10, after my test runs) already answers them. The probe driver probe-4.10.sh still stops at 5h over 95 or week over 90 (PM 2026-11-18), which disagrees with the spec D15 night limit of 95/100 (F3).
blocking_findings: F1 (blocking, harness/model-guide/quota.ts:273-275): the Go branch of stateOf reads windows["week"], but the live endpoint GET /api/quota/opencode-go names the week window weekly. I read the live answer: windows are 5h, weekly, monthly, credits_balance. There is no week key. The week-100 wait of spec D15 never fires live, so the runner never stops a Go pass at the week limit. The fakes of quota.test.ts (goBody, line 285), review-run.test.ts (line 487), and judge-run.test.ts (line 547) all serve week, so the tests confirm a dead key. Convergent with Review A cc8afbd F1. Fix: read windows["weekly"] (keep week only as a documented fallback), fix the answer example at quota.ts:28 and spec D15/FR-15 to name the live keys, and serve the live window set in the three fakes.

F2 (blocking, harness/model-guide/quota.ts:259-261): parseAnswer rejects any window whose usedPercent is not a number. The live answer holds credits_balance with usedPercent null. So every live Go read returns stopped. I ran harness/model-guide/quota.ts --provider opencode-go --base http://127.0.0.1:38307 and got {"state":"stopped"} with the stderr line quota: the window credits_balance holds no usable usedPercent. The Go thresholds of task 4.13h can never be evaluated live: review-run.sh writes an open pass with a quota error and the probe refuses. The strict check is pre-existing (task 4.4, commit 9c1dfa6), but 4.13h made the live Go read the enforcement point. Convergent with Review A cc8afbd F2. Fix: skip a window with a null or unusable usedPercent (a missing window never moves the state), and pin the live answer with a null credits_balance in the fakes. An uncommitted task 4.13i Red (Q11 to Q15) in the working tree already covers both fixes; it must land and pass before the phase gate.
nonblocking_findings: F3 (minor, /home/daniebo/.local/share/lending-desk-bench/model-guide/jobs/probe-4.10.sh:60-76): the probe driver keeps the PM 2026-11-18 night gate five over 95 or week over 90, but spec D15 after commit 84e254e sets the Go night limit at 95 % / 100 %, and night-4.11.sh (line 78, updated Nov 19 00:12) and quota.ts follow it. The probe is stricter, so it stops the re-probe of the two Go pilot routes (row 4.13h, 02:00 +07 tonight) at a week of 91 to 100 that the runner would allow. No spend risk; the direction is safe. The live weekly value is 1.17 % now, so tonight is not hit. Convergent with Review A cc8afbd N2. Fix: the orchestrator aligns the probe gate to five at 95 or more and week at 100 or more.

F4 (nit, measure/tracks/model_guide/plan.md:1873-1876): row 4.12 still says the night limit is the Go 5-hour window over 95 % or the Go week over 90 % (PM 2026-11-18), but spec D15 now says the night limit is the same 95 % / 100 % (PM 2026-11-19), and night-4.11.sh follows the spec. The text commits def8681 and 84e254e missed this row. Fix: update the row 4.12 sentence to 95 % / 100 %.

F5 (nit, measure/tracks/model_guide/spec.md:721): D14 says the probe retry ceiling is pinned as test P2 pins, but P2 pins only that the probe made more than 0 calls (review-run.test.ts:1775); the ceiling pin lives in P2b (review-run.test.ts:2540, exactly 3 calls). The substance of R1 is resolved; only the cross-reference is stale. Fix: change the spec text to as test P2b pins.

F6 (nit, harness/model-guide-tests/review-run.test.ts:1373 and afterAll at :179): my first review-run run failed 2 cases (R12 and the unnamed afterAll) on live-fake-process assertions that named fixture dirs mg-adv-r-run-kKpMvB and mg-adv-r-run-f4GzZO. The isolated re-run of the same suite passed 52 of 52 with the same code, and every pgrep scan before and after printed no line. A heavy-run vitest job of another project ran through the whole audit, and an in-flight Green Red (task 4.13i) began in this worktree at 01:09. I could not attribute the two orphans to a pid, and both fixture dirs were gone when I looked. The failure is an orphan-detection flake under machine load, not a contract break. Fix: give R12 and the afterAll a short settle wait before the process scan.

F7 (nit, pre-existing, harness/model-guide/judge-run.sh:691-698): the 80 % stop branch is dead for every sourced provider, because a window at 80 already gives the wait state and the wait branch at line 683 stops the run first. The comment at lines 670-673 still describes an 80 % stop that cannot occur. The 4.13h diff only added the IS_GO_ROUTE guard to the dead branch. Convergent with Review A cc8afbd N1. Fix: drop the dead branch and fix the comment, or gate the wait branch at 80 for mid-run stops.

Its Go gate stays at 5h over 95 or week over 90 (F3).
